programmes.d: Sylvester Stallone reflects on being recognizable worldwide and issues in his private life. Actor Orson Bean recalls the early days of TV and makes fun of daytime talk show topics.
Oscar nom'd George Segal demonstrates playing an old man using prosthetics, glasses and gait. Comedian Drew Carey riffs on his high school reunion, driving a Yugo and his love of bad food.
Whipped cream anyone? Burt Reynolds shows a clip of him squirting whipped cream down Johnny's trousers. Burt then shoves a can in his own pants and sprays his crotch.
Comic actress Lily Tomlin talks about her family's reaction to her one-woman concert and recounts her brother's arrest in Detroit for being in a car with a black woman.
Rocky star Sylvester Stallone brings son Sage to meet Johnny. Describes getting kicked out of several schools, and chats about stardom with fellow guest Steve Martin.
Felix Unger reborn! TV veteran Tony Randall chats about his new role as a Philadelphia judge on The Tony Randall Show. Also tells Johnny he's quit the booze.
Felix Unger gets sexy? Actor Tony Randall spills the beans on his early experiences with girls and the first time he bought condoms. Also opines on sex education classes.

Comic actress Teri Garr creates a stir on Johnny's set in her see-through blouse. Shows a clip from her Oscar-nom'd performance in Tootsie, and parses success in show biz vs. recognition as an actress.
Movie icon Susan Sarandon talks about her bad luck, plus Jack Palance and Joanna Cassidy stop by.
Adrienne Barbeau has received some strange Christmas presents! Plus, Johnny interviews Richard Harris and Bob Hope.

George Peppard gets relatable when he reveals that he doesn't like himself when he looks in the mirror. Plus, Charles O. Finley talks about orange baseballs, Geoffrey Bourne discusses his book and Charlie Callas does standup.
George Miller does standup, Robert Mitchum talks about his marijuana conviction, and Dick Van Patten and stuntman Dennis Madalone appear.
Sally Field details her relationship with Burt Reynolds. Plus, Buddy Hackett reveals his arguing strategy with his wife.
James Woods has some marriage advice. McLean Stevenson and Bum Phillips also have something to say about wives and matrimony.
Albert Brooks talks puppy love, Susan Sarandon talks clam shucking and Carnac the Magnificent works his magic.
James Woods talks body casts, Peter Billingsley plans to quit acting when he turns 18 and Martin Mull takes an audience poll.
Hulkomania takes over The Tonight Show! How do George Miller and Brooke Shields follow that??
Sally Field wants to shed her "cute little girl" image. Plus, things get Christmassy on the Tonight Show set.
Brooke Shields discusses Sahara, Albert Brooks goes on a mild tirade and Johnny jokes about President Reagan.
Carrie Fisher talks Return of the Jedi and Garry Shandling gets more than a few laughs.
Susan Sarandon, Brooke Shields and Carol Wayne all stop by the couch, and Johnny talks about Playboy.
Ed Begley Jr. discusses starting out in the business. Suzanne Pleshette and Michael Davis also appear.
Small screen icon Farrah Fawcett discusses her new TV movie, and Ryan O'Neal is obsessed with her.
Ed Begley Jr. returns and is joined by Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom's Kate Capshaw and comedian Bobby Kelton.
John Lithgow and Buddy Hackett stop by the couch, plus Johnny talks about the Christmas season.
